newsitem.title: CHINA: Profits of China's CITIC up 20 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Profits of China's CITIC up 20 percent in 1996.

text.p: Profits of China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC) increased by more than 20 percent in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Xinhua did not give a figure or say whether it was post- or after-tax profits.
CITIC's assets and equity also increased by more than 20 percent, the agency said.
Its ratio of liabilities to assets fell, Xinhua said without elaborating.

Profits of CITIC's Industrial Bank soared by nearly 57 percent last year compared with the previous year, it said, adding that bank maintained its rank among the top six domestic commercial banks in terms of profits and assets.

CITIC Securities Co Ltd made profits of 216 million yuan ($26 million) in its first year of operation and became one of the first 10 securities firms to be accorded underwriter status by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, Xinhua said.
